content: In the first approach, we frame the MR task as a QA task and generate questions using the template: “What is the $ <$dosage/frequency$>$ for $<$Medication Name$>$". Here, we use an abstractive QA model based on pointer-generator networks BIBREF9 augmented with coattention encoder BIBREF10 (QA-PGNet).
